summary: title: Google Antigravity tags: coding-agent, google-gemini, llm-provider, multi-agent # Google Antigravity Google's agentic coding platform, evolved from Gemini CLI. At Google I/O 2026 (May 19), announced as a full agent development and management platform with multi-agent orchestration, CLI, SDK, and standalone desktop app. ## Overview - Developer : Google - Previous Name : Gemini CLI (transitioned May 12, 2026; cutoff for free Gemini Code Assist June 18, 2026) - Backend Model : Gemini 3.5 Flash (default), Gemini 3.1 Pro, Claude, GPT-OSS - Interface : CLI (Go rewrite), Desktop app (Antigravity 2.0), IDE plugin, SDK, API - Pricing : Free (capped), AI Pro ($19.99/mo), AI Ultra ($99.99–$200/mo) - Open Source : Core open source (google-gemini-cli → antigravity-cli) ## Key Capabilities - Autonomous code editing and project scaffolding - Multi-agent suite with dynamic subagents - Built-in browser for web-based workflows - Google Cloud and Vertex AI integration - MCP tool support - SDK for building custom agent workflows - Gemini 3.5 Flash: 4× faster output than peers, <50% cost of comparable frontier models ## Recent Updates (May–June 2026) - Google I/O 2026 (May 19, 2026) : Major announcements — "agentic Gemini era" - Gemini 3.5 Flash : GA across all products and APIs — Terminal-Bench 76.2%, GDPval-AA 1656 Elo, MCP Atlas 83.6% - Gemini Omni Flash : "Create anything from anything" — first in Omni family, generates any output modality from any input - Gemini 3.5 Pro : Internal use; public rollout expected June–July 2026 - Antigravity 2.0 : Standalone desktop app for agent management, multi-surface platform (IDE → CLI → SDK → API → Cloud) - Gemini CLI → Antigravity CLI : Transition announced May 12, 2026; free tier cutoff June 18, 2026 - AI Mode : >1B monthly users (queries doubling each quarter) - Google CapEx : $180B–$190B expected for full-year 2026 - 8.5M+ developers building with Google models monthly; 19B tokens/minute via APIs ## Notable Features - Multi-model choice : Gemini, Claude, GPT-OSS - Multi-agent orchestration : Dynamic subagents, built-in browser - Deep Google ecosystem : Android, Google Cloud, Vertex AI integration - Speed advantage : Gemini 3.5 Flash at 289 tokens/sec (4× faster than peers) - Cost efficiency : <50% cost of comparable frontier models ## Competitive Positioning - Multi-surface platform strategy (IDE, CLI, SDK, API, Cloud) most comprehensive - Gemini 3.5 Flash is strongest value proposition in frontier tier - UX disruption risk (IDE removal, free tier changes) has caused user concern - Direct competitor to Claude Code (agent depth), Cursor (IDE), Codex (ecosystem) - Growing adoption through Google Cloud customers (375+ processed >1T tokens/year) ## Related - [[google-gemini]] — Provider - [[openai-codex]] — Competitor - [[claude-code]] — Competitor - [[cursor]] — Competitor - [[context-windows]] — Context window technology
